raw_response:
I am 47. I have farmed 36 mu in Quzhou County for 30 years, since I was 17. I never went to school. I cannot read well. Everything I know, I learned from my father and from watching my neighbors. If I see a field with big ears and thick bolls, I ask what they used. That is my school.

I plant 20 mu of summer maize. After the wheat comes off in June, I hire the rotary tiller. It costs 30 yuan per mu. I plant hybrid seed, the same kind my neighbor Wang used last year. His maize was tall and the ears were heavy. At planting, I spread one 50-kilogram bag of compound fertilizer on every mu. When the maize grows to my knee, I top-dress with 30 kilograms of urea per mu. I know that is a lot. But last year I used the same, and my maize stayed dark green until harvest. If I cut back and the leaves turn yellow, I lose everything. A bad harvest is a disaster. Wasting some fertilizer is just money spent. I irrigate 3 times with my well pump: once after planting, once when the tassels show, and once when the ears are filling. I spray pesticide 2 times, when I see worms on the leaves. I expect 1200 jin per mu, same as last year.

I plant 10 mu of cotton. Cotton needs deep soft soil, so I plough it in spring with a tractor. I use improved seed from the shop, not the old kind. Cotton eats more than maize. I put down one 50-kilogram bag of compound fertilizer per mu at planting. Later, when the plants flower, I add 35 kilograms of urea per mu. Cotton is greedy. My cousin once used less and her cotton got yellow leaves and small bolls. I water 4 times through the summer because July is hot and cotton drinks a lot. I spray pesticide 6 times. Bollworms come every year. I expect about 560 jin of seed cotton per mu.

The remaining 6 mu I plant mungbean. Mungbean is easy. I use my own saved seeds, the traditional kind. I put only half a bag — 25 kilograms — of compound fertilizer per mu. Mungbean makes its own nitrogen. My mother-in-law told me that, and I see it on my field. I water 2 times and spray 2 times for aphids. If I get 200 jin per mu, I am happy.

I think about costs every day. A bag of fertilizer is over 100 yuan. With 36 mu, that is many bags. But I have four people in my house, and some work off-farm, but the land is our base. I watch what my neighbors do. If they put one bag per mu, I put one bag per mu. If my field looks thin next to theirs, I lose face and I lose money. So I will do what I did last year. Last year was good. Change is dangerous.
